items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I had a teacher who said he went to I think Ithaca College perhaps. Greg Prios. Great teacher. Great musician, great teacher.

ctx.x: I’ll never practice — when I was a kid I had a teacher who said he went to I think Ithaca College perhaps. Greg Prios. Great teacher. Great musician, great teacher. And he said to me, “If you’re practicing with records, don’t use live recordings. More often than not the time is moving around more than you’d care to hear.” And I stuck with that and it’s sort of true. You can find great live recordings obviously that aren’t like that, but more often © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
than not if I were going to practice something at a certain tempo to work out a brush stroke or just lock in a groove, I’d probably use something that was not live.
